description: Header file defining the dm_bss_t class for managing Basic Service Set (BSS) information, including initialization, encoding/decoding JSON, comparison, parsing, and vendor IE management.

classes.name: dm_bss_t
classes.description: Represents and manages BSS information, providing methods for initialization, JSON encoding/decoding, comparison, parsing BSS IDs, and vendor-specific IE management.

methods.name: int init()
methods.description: Initializes the BSS information structure by setting it to zero.

methods.name: em_bss_info_t * get_bss_info()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the internal BSS information structure.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object to populate BSS information, associating it with a parent ID.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes BSS information into a JSON object, with an optional summary mode.

methods.name: operator ==
methods.description: Compares this BSS object with another for equality.

methods.name: operator =
methods.description: Assigns one BSS object to another.

methods.name: match_criteria
methods.description: Checks if the BSS matches specific criteria string.

methods.name: parse_bss_id_from_key
methods.description: Parses a BSS ID from a given key string.

methods.name: add_vendor_ie
methods.description: Adds a vendor-specific information element to the BSS.

methods.name: remove_vendor_ie
methods.description: Removes a specified vendor-specific information element.

methods.name: dm_bss_t (constructor)
methods.description: Constructs a new dm_bss_t instance from a pointer to BSS info.

methods.name: ~dm_bss_t (destructor)
methods.description: Cleans up resources used by the dm_bss_t instance.
